name: Melor Stonehoof
summary: On Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, Melor Stonehoof sets hunters to difficult trials. He sends Horde hunters after dangerous beasts across the Barrens and Thousand Needles to test their tracking and mettle.

sections.title: A Mentor of the Wilds
sections.body: Melor Stonehoof watches the plains from Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. For the tauren, hunting joins survival with spiritual balance and respect for nature's greatest predators. Melor teaches those who carry bow and blade for the Horde to honor that balance, sending promising stalkers to test their craft against legendary beasts.

sections.title: Trials of the Hunt
sections.body: Melor sends hunters after elusive beasts that threaten the wilds. In the Barrens, they aid the huntress Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads, then pursue Steelsnap, a cunning and vicious hyena in Thousand Needles. These trials test whether hunters can outsmart and outfight the deadliest creatures of central Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Monsters of Distant Lands
sections.body: Hunters who prove their skill in the Barrens face beasts in distant lands. Melor sends seasoned hunters after Deadmire, an ancient crocolisk in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh, and Frostmaw, a savage yeti in the Alterac Mountains. Each hunt tests whether a stalker has mastered the Hunter's Way.

faq.q: Where can I find Melor Stonehoof?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof is on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. The mesa lies south of the main bluff of the tauren capital, reached by rope bridges.

faq.q: What quests does Melor Stonehoof offer?
faq.answer: Melor offers a series of hunting challenges for mid-level adventurers. He directs hunters to Sergra Darkthorn in the Barrens, sends them after the ferocious hyena Steelsnap, and points them toward Deadmire in Dustwallow Marsh and Frostmaw in the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Melor send hunters after Steelsnap?
faq.answer: Steelsnap is a vicious, cunning hyena that stalks Thousand Needles. Melor sends capable hunters to track and slay him, testing their skill, endurance, and courage in the wild.
Deadmire is an unusually large, aggressive crocolisk in the swamps of Dustwallow Marsh. Melor challenges hunters to slay it as a test of prowess.

faq.q: Do you need to be a hunter class to take his quests?
aliases: can other classes do melor quests
faq.answer: No. Melor offers his hunting trials to any capable adventurer fighting for the Horde. They reflect the hunter's way and suit the hunter class.

faq.q: Who is Sergra Darkthorn, and why does Melor send you to her?
faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn is an orc huntress at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Melor sends promising hunters to aid her in subduing the plains' unruly predators and learn from another veteran of the wild.

angles.text: As a hunter, you follow Melor's tracking trials along the sacred path of the hunt.
As a tauren, you see in Melor a deep reverence for the hunt, a trial of strength held in balance with the Earth Mother.
As a member of the Horde, you face the wild beasts that endanger settlements from Mulgore to Thousand Needles. Melor hardens warriors and stalkers for that work.
